author: RogerJlk

title: Has major bugs
body: I love the app but it has some major bugs that has been there for years on both iOS and macOS. The most annoying one is copy pasting. I sometimes copy something from it and when I paste in another note, it pastes something completely different! This made me lose data quite a few of times!

title: Thank you.
body: This has helped me with not only writing notes for school for example, but also, for expressing my feelings. Everyday, I write about my day, and if I’m feeling down, I spill out my anger on writing in notes. Thank you, for this masterpiece.
